name: git-hygiene
description: Manages branches and linked worktrees through positive evidence rather than guesses. It places agent-created worktrees under a configured hidden root, reports cleanup candidates automatically, and moves or removes only exact worktrees proved safe by a deterministic re-check after approval. Branch cleanup remains separate, and unknown evidence always means keep.

interface.shortDescription: Branch and worktree cleanup, proved safe
interface.longDescription: Git Hygiene separates age from deletion evidence for branches and manages linked worktrees through one deterministic engine. Nothing is removed until it is proved safe. Agent-created worktrees use a configured hidden root. Status is read-only, session startup reports visible clutter, and direct mutating worktree commands are routed through the governed skill when enforcement is enabled. Moving, unlocking, and removing require approval, exact paths, and immediate re-checks. Dirty, locked, open, detached, unique, or unknown worktrees remain untouched, and worktree cleanup never deletes branches.
